title: The rug is a bit thin and small but it is fluffy and my cat loves it; it does shet
text: The rug is a bit thin and small but it is fluffy and my cat loves it; it does shet. I got this for my cat to lay on (as you can see in the picture). It is very small. The measurements are of the longest width and the longest length (such as from the top of the head to the tip of the toe). It is very soft on the underside. There was no label on my rug. I assume it can be machine washed and hung dry. I already have another rug very similar (but a bit thicker) that I wash periodically. However, this does shed a bit where my other rugs like this do not.

This asymmetrical rug imitates authentic sheepskin cowhide shape, and whether you use this gorgeous accent piece by your fireplace or in your foyer, it will be a perfect addition and will bring an effortless cozy flair Into your home. Set this fluffy rug by your bedside in your bedroom, kids & baby room, or playroom for soft stepping and a safe landing spot. This luxurious rug will instantly accent and warm up your space as a throw on your favorite armchair or recliner as well.
